cultural.vision_reason: Studio cabinet-card portrait of a Mapuche family (man, woman, baby in wooden cradle) in traditional manta, trarilonko headband, and chaway earrings, photographed by Gustavo Milet in Traiguén, Chile — clear documentary dress photo of the claimed people.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); cabinet card
physical.classification: photographic print (black and white); cabinet card
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white); cabinet card; a studio portrait of a Mapuche man, woman and baby seen standing in profile, posed in front of a painted background of an outdoor scene; the man is holding a stick in one hand and wears a chamal or trarilanko (headband) and manta (blanket/poncho); the woman wears a trarilonko (hair lace/headgear), chaway (earrings),and manta, and she carries the baby in a baby carrier made of wood and cord on her back; Traiguen, Chile. 
Albumen print
